lesson: Converge disputes by ARTIFACT, not averaging (2026-09-15): auditor false-negatived the musyawarah gate as 'nonexistent'; resolution came from primary evidence (patch, commit 3ebe0898c, live dry-run 2607+3477 exempt), not debate. Root cause: orchestrator gave auditor incomplete search paths (hooks/ only; gate lives in scripts/). Iron addendum: auditor scope MUST include scripts/ trees — and the auditor's refuse-to-certify-unseen discipline is what made the resolution trustworthy.
